_about: Every line of dialogue in the game. Edit the text freely; keep the ids.
A line is either plain text or {"text", "speaker", "next", "choices"}.
speaker: an NPC id or "hero" (the player); left out = whoever you are talking to.
next: the id of the line that follows (a Continue button). choices: [{"text": your answer, "next": line id}].
Ids follow conventions the game looks for: npc.<npc>.greeting, npc.<npc>.greeting.<world flag>,
quest.<quest>.offer / progress / complete / accepted / declined / failed / world_flag,
quest.<quest>.accept / decline (your answers), quest.<quest>.interact.<i> / deliver.<i> / escort.<i>,
quest.<quest>.spot.<i>.<n> (what you find at investigate spot n of objective i).
A missing line falls back to a short default text.

lines.npc.apothecary_odo.greeting: Draughts for the body, draughts for the mind. Odo's tinctures never curdle. Well. Rarely.
lines.npc.elder_tsaga.greeting: The wind told me you were coming, stranger. The wells are dry, the iron wolves are bold, and the stones are restless. Sit by the fire.
lines.npc.healer_wenna.greeting: Wenna Ashby, healer. Sit if you're bleeding. And don't drink from the river — it's run grey upstream for weeks, and nobody will tell me why.
lines.npc.innkeeper_bram.greeting: Welcome to the Crossed Keys! Every road in the Heartland ends at my door sooner or later. Mind the Bedrun lads, they sing.
lines.npc.steward_marl.greeting: Orrin Marl, steward of Deepcut. The mine pays the town, the town pays the Guild, and the stream pays for all of it. Don't drink it.
lines.npc.trader_tamsin.greeting: Tamsin Reed. Scrolls, blades, boots: whatever comes up the roads, I sell it on.
lines.npc.collapsed_shaft.greeting: Old timbers and loose rock choke the shaft mouth. Cold air sighs out of the gaps.
lines.npc.foreman_brannoc.greeting: Hadda Brannoc, foreman of this Bedrun crew. If you're not here to dig or to help, you're in the way.
lines.npc.guild_board.greeting: The Guild Board. Notices from the Floor Guild are pinned in neat rows, each stamped with a blue seal.
lines.npc.hilda.greeting: Welcome to Millbrook, traveler! I buy what you find out there and sell what you'll need to stay alive.
lines.npc.maren.greeting: Mind the old graveyard, child. The dead rest easy here — it's the living out east who worry me.
lines.npc.mine_board.greeting: The Mine Board, nailed to a pit-prop. Bedrun work notices in ochre chalk, some half rubbed out by rain.
lines.npc.ore_caravan.greeting: A Bedrun ore wagon, axles groaning under its load. The drover keeps one eye on the canyon rim.
lines.npc.reset_shrine.greeting: You lay a hand on the warm stone. Every creature in the testing grounds returns to its pen at full strength, and every lingering effect fades.
lines.npc.rowan.greeting: The wolves of Greenfields grow bolder every week. If you can swing a blade, the town could use you.
lines.npc.rowan.greeting.grizzlehide_slain: Millbrook owes you, hero. With Grizzlehide gone, the shepherds are back in the fields.
lines.npc.sabra_venn.greeting: Sabra Venn, of the Ember Hand. Warm day, isn't it? Warmer down in Deepcut, I hear.
lines.npc.seer_ilyth.about_vael: We were here before the roads. We listen to the old stones, and lately they have been loud.

npc.seer_ilyth.greeting.text: The Vael remember what the land forgets. Sit, if you like. Or walk on: the stones will wait.

lines.npc.vael_stone.greeting: A standing stone, taller than a man, carved with spirals worn almost smooth. It is warm to the touch.
lines.npc.warden_dorne.about_ember: Fire-priests from the south. They pay well and smile too much. Mind what you sign for them.

npc.warden_dorne.about_guild.text: We keep the roads, the bridges and the ledgers. Dull work, until something burns.

lines.npc.warden_dorne.about_guild_2: And lately something has been burning.

npc.warden_dorne.greeting.text: Iska Dorne, Warden of the Floor Guild hall here at the Crossing. If the board sent you, you're the help I asked for.

lines.npc.warden_dorne.greeting.act1_complete: The stone, the caravan, the Ember Hand's paper... you've seen more of this than anyone. The Guild won't forget it.
lines.quest.act1_ash_on_the_road.accepted: The places glow to a careful eye. Look for them, and examine each one.
lines.quest.act1_ash_on_the_road.complete: Ash in circles, a red wax seal, and the smell of oil. That's no lightning. That's the Ember Hand.
lines.quest.act1_ash_on_the_road.declined: When you're ready, then. The ash isn't going anywhere.
lines.quest.act1_ash_on_the_road.offer: Travellers talk of scorched ground along the road through Greenfields: grass burnt in circles, no campfire anywhere near. Go and look at three of those places. Tell me what you find.
lines.quest.act1_ash_on_the_road.progress: Three scorched places. They're marked if you know how to look.

quest.act1_ash_on_the_road.spot.0.0.speaker: hero
quest.act1_ash_on_the_road.spot.0.0.text: A ring of burnt grass, perfectly round. In the middle, a scrap of red wax.

quest.act1_ash_on_the_road.spot.0.1.speaker: hero
quest.act1_ash_on_the_road.spot.0.1.text: Scorched earth by the road. Something heavy was dragged through the ash, toward the east.

quest.act1_ash_on_the_road.spot.0.2.speaker: hero
quest.act1_ash_on_the_road.spot.0.2.text: Blackened stones, still faintly warm, and a smell of lamp oil.

lines.quest.act1_ember_writ.accepted: Don't break the seal. It would only upset you.
lines.quest.act1_ember_writ.complete: They'll get their answer. Thank you for carrying it, whatever was in it.
lines.quest.act1_ember_writ.declined: Pity. The Hand remembers its friends... and the others.
lines.quest.act1_ember_writ.deliver.0: An Ember Hand seal. Of course. They want my ore, and they want it cheap.
lines.quest.act1_ember_writ.offer: You've been poking around the burnt fields, haven't you? Let's be friends. Take this writ to Foreman Brannoc at the Deepcut mine, east along the Road to Deepcut. She'll want what's in it.
lines.quest.act1_ember_writ.progress: The Ember Hand sent you? Then you've got something for me.
lines.quest.act1_guild_summons.complete: You came. Good. Here's for your boots; you'll wear them out soon enough.
lines.quest.act1_guild_summons.offer: SUMMONS: Capable hands wanted by the Floor Guild. Report to Warden Dorne at the Guild Hall, here at the Crossing. Pay on arrival.
lines.quest.act1_ore_for_millbrook.accepted: Talk to the drover when you're ready to roll. It won't go faster than you can follow.
lines.quest.act1_ore_for_millbrook.complete: Bedrun ore out of Deepcut, and not one coin paid to the Ember Hand. Brannoc owes you, and frankly so do I.

quest.act1_ore_for_millbrook.escort.0.speaker: ore_caravan
quest.act1_ore_for_millbrook.escort.0.text: Hup! Stay close, the wolves smell the mules from a mile off.

lines.quest.act1_ore_for_millbrook.failed: The caravan's lost. Brannoc will want to try again.
lines.quest.act1_ore_for_millbrook.offer: That writ says the Hand will buy our ore at the mine mouth, or we'll find the road unsafe. Well, I'd rather sell to Millbrook. Walk my caravan down the street to the canyon gate, and keep the Hand's fire hounds off it.
lines.quest.act1_ore_for_millbrook.progress: My caravan. Is it out of the canyon yet?
lines.quest.act1_ore_for_millbrook.restart: The wagon's patched and the drover's sober. Shall we try the road again?
lines.quest.act1_what_the_stone_remembers.comp: Then the Ember Hand is waking something under the Heartland. This is only the first page of it. Rest; we will need you.

quest.act1_what_the_stone_remembers.inte.speaker: hero
quest.act1_what_the_stone_remembers.inte.text: Warmth runs up your arm. For a moment you see figures in red robes, pouring oil into the earth, and the stone glowing back at them.

lines.quest.act1_what_the_stone_remembers.offe: The fires on the road lead toward an old Vael stone on the Windsteppe, west of the Crossing. Lay your hand on it, and drive off the iron wolves that prowl around it. The stone will tell you what it saw.
lines.quest.act1_what_the_stone_remembers.prog: Have you touched the stone? Have the wolves gone?
lines.quest.act1_what_the_stone_remembers.worl: End of Act I (prototype): the Vael stone has spoken. Something stirs beneath the Heartland.
lines.quest.bandit_camp.complete: Bandits gone, but they'd been hunting a bear — a huge, scarred one. That's worse news than bandits.
lines.quest.bandit_camp.offer: Those wolves were fleeing something. Scouts saw bandits camped at the southern end of Greenfields, across the river. Find their camp (look for the red banner) and break their two brutes.
lines.quest.bandit_camp.progress: Cross the river by the bridge nearest the town road; the camp is just past it, under a red banner. Mind the brutes: slow, but they hit like a falling tree.
lines.quest.beast_of_greenfields.complete: You actually did it. Greenfields is ours again. Take your pick from the armoury — you've earned it.
lines.quest.beast_of_greenfields.offer: Old Grizzlehide. He roams the fields between the river crossings and nothing alone survives him. Gather friends — at least four — and end him.
lines.quest.beast_of_greenfields.progress: Grizzlehide walks a loop through the middle of the fields. Don't fight him alone.
lines.quest.beast_of_greenfields.world_flag: Bells ring in Millbrook: Old Grizzlehide is dead!
lines.quest.goblin_fetishes.complete: Ugh, they still hum. Into the fire they go. Take something for your pains.
lines.quest.goblin_fetishes.offer: The goblin shamans on the western hill carve fetishes that sour the wells. Bring me five and I'll see them burned.
lines.quest.goblin_fetishes.progress: Five fetishes, child. The shamans keep their distance — corner them or out-shoot them.
lines.quest.side_bandits_on_the_ore_road.compl: Both of them? You're worth your weight in copper. Here.
lines.quest.side_bandits_on_the_ore_road.offer: BOUNTY: two bandit brutes waylay ore wagons south of the camp. Break them. Payment from Foreman Brannoc.
lines.quest.side_bandits_on_the_ore_road.progr: Those brutes still about? They're south, by the red banner.
lines.quest.side_collapsed_shaft.complete: Noted on the board: Shaft Seven is breathing. You add a chalk mark under the notice.

quest.side_collapsed_shaft.interact.0.speaker: hero
quest.side_collapsed_shaft.interact.0.text: You press your ear to the rocks. Far below, something knocks, slow and steady, like a heartbeat.

lines.quest.side_collapsed_shaft.offer: NOTICE: Shaft Seven collapsed in the spring. Someone check whether it is still breathing. (The shaft, not the miners. Probably.)
lines.quest.side_guild_patrol.complete: Bridge standing, river flowing. Dull is good. Thank you.
lines.quest.side_guild_patrol.offer: PATROL: Walk to the north bridge in Greenfields and back. Report anything odd to Warden Dorne.
lines.quest.side_guild_patrol.progress: The north bridge, then back to me.
lines.quest.wolves_at_the_gate.complete: Good work. The shepherds will sleep easier. I may have more for you.
lines.quest.wolves_at_the_gate.offer: Wolves have been taking sheep right outside the east gate. Thin the pack: four should teach them.
lines.quest.wolves_at_the_gate.progress: Four wolves. They hunt in the fields just past the gate.
lines.quest.word_to_hilda.complete: Frost, eh? Thank Maren for telling me. Here, take these for your trouble.
lines.quest.word_to_hilda.offer: Hilda at the stall has been asking after my herbs. Tell her the frost got them this year, would you? My knees won't carry me there.
